roadmap.title: Quick wins
roadmap.description: Short one-off actions you can finish in your first sessions.

roadmap.title: Stats and counters
roadmap.description: Train stats and work through fights, crafting, favours and jobs-light goals.

roadmap.title: Long cumulative goals
roadmap.description: Time, tag and job goals that build up across prisons and sessions.

roadmap.title: Base-game escapes
roadmap.description: Escape every classic and transport prison, then the dolphin route.

roadmap.title: Online play
roadmap.description: Online Classic and Versus goals that need another player.

roadmap.title: DLC prisons
roadmap.description: Wicked Ward, Big Top Breakout and Dungeons and Duct Tape.

achievements.summary: Raise the Strength stat to 100.

steps.text: Use the gym equipment and finish the Q and E timing minigame until Strength reaches 100.

achievements.summary: Raise the Intellect stat to 100.

steps.text: Read at the bookstacks and finish the Q and E timing minigame until Intellect reaches 100.

achievements.summary: Raise the Fitness stat to 100.

steps.text: Use the exercise equipment and finish the Q and E timing minigame until Fitness reaches 100.

achievements.summary: Raise Strength, Fitness and Intellect to 100 in the same session.

guide.context: All three stats must reach 100 in one session, so do not leave the save between them.

steps.text: Train Strength and Fitness on the equipment.
Read at the bookstacks for Intellect, and keep going until all three stats show 100.

achievements.summary: Knock out 100 inmates.

guide.context: Progress carries across prisons.

steps.text: Fight inmates with your fists or a weapon until each one is knocked out. Do this 100 times.

achievements.summary: Knock out 50 guards.

guide.context: Hitting a guard raises your heat to 100, so pick your moment.

steps.text: Ambush a guard who is alone in a quiet area and knock him out. Do this 50 times.

achievements.description: Get whisked away by a hunky medic.
achievements.summary: Get knocked out and carried to the infirmary by a medic.

steps.text: Lose a fight to an inmate, a guard or a dog. When the medic carries you into the infirmary, the achievement unlocks.

achievements.summary: Craft any item.

steps.text: Collect the ingredients for any recipe you have the Intellect for, then craft it from the crafting menu.

achievements.summary: Escape all seven classic prisons.

guide.context: Any escape route counts for each prison.

steps.text: Escape Centre Perks 2.0, Rattlesnake Springs, K.A.P.O.W Camp, H.M.P Offshore, Fort Tundra, Area 17 and U.S.S Anomaly.

achievements.summary: Craft 50 different items.

guide.context: Repeats do not count, and some recipes exist only in certain prisons.

steps.text: Craft a new item type each time until you have made 50 different ones.

achievements.description: Perform 7 unique escapes across the Classic prisons.
achievements.summary: Perform 7 different escapes in the classic prisons.

guide.context: Escapes from the transport prisons do not count. The criminal profile in the main menu lists your finished escapes.

steps.text: Complete escapes in the classic prisons until the profile shows 7 different ones. They can come from the same prison, such as a perimeter breakout, the single-player escape or the multiplayer escape.

achievements.description: Knock out every inmate at least once in a single prison.
achievements.summary: Knock out every inmate in one prison at least once.

guide.context: Area 17 has only four other inmates, and they are often alone.

steps.text: Start a new game in Area 17.
Knock out each inmate once in the same prison without leaving the session.

achievements.description: Escape from all 3 of the base game transport prisons
achievements.summary: Escape Cougar Creek Railroad, H.M.S Orca and Air Force Con.

guide.context: These prisons have a time limit, you cannot leave your cell safely, and your Intellect starts at 70. Items are in desks around each prison.

steps.text: On Cougar Creek Railroad, craft a Pretend Carrot from an orange pen, a green pen and a handkerchief, then use it in the second wagon.
On H.M.S Orca, craft a Makeshift Breathing Apparatus from duct tape, tubing and an oxygen tank, then use it on the top deck.
On Air Force Con, craft a Parachute from 3 ropes, then escape above the cells.

achievements.summary: Win 10 online Versus games.

guide.context: A win means escaping first.

steps.text: Play Versus online and escape first in 10 games. Transport prisons are quickest, and a friend can let you win.

achievements.summary: Escape H.M.P Offshore.

guide.context: Any route counts.

steps.text: Reach Intellect 60 and craft a plastic red key. Take a guard outfit and put it on.
Shut off the generator in the west, craft flimsy cutters or better, and cut the fence at the marked spot.
Walk onto the boat to escape.

achievements.summary: Escape Centre Perks 2.0.

guide.context: Any route counts.

steps.text: Reach Intellect 50. Craft flimsy cutters and a bed dummy, and put the dummy in your bed.
Attend roll call, then go out the north-west purple door before 23:00.
Wait at the fence until 01:00, avoid the spotlights, then cut the fence.

achievements.summary: Escape U.S.S Anomaly.

guide.context: Any route counts.

steps.text: Craft sturdy cutters and find a screwdriver.
Go north, climb the stairs by the showers, and cut the fence.
Open the vent with the screwdriver, cut the fences inside, leave the vent and walk north.

achievements.summary: Escape Rattlesnake Springs.

guide.context: Any route counts.

steps.text: Reach Strength 40 and Intellect 50, and take the painting job.
Craft a flimsy shovel and dig at the marked spot until it is at 10% use, then upgrade to a lightweight pickaxe and keep digging.
Drop down the hole, go east, dig through the debris with the pickaxe and then the shovel, and walk through the tunnel.

achievements.summary: Escape K.A.P.O.W Camp.

guide.context: Any route counts.

steps.text: Reach Intellect 60. Craft lightweight cutters or better and a plastic red key, and wear a guard outfit.
After roll call, switch off the generator at 00:00, then run south past the disabled metal detector.
Cut the fence at the marked spot and leave.

achievements.summary: Escape Fort Tundra.

guide.context: Any route counts.

steps.text: Reach Intellect 70 and finish the "Rock-Hammer Hard Place" favour to get a rock hammer.
Craft lightweight cutters or better and a bed dummy in your bed.
After roll call go to the sewer entrance left of the statue, and stay out of your cell until 00:00.
Hit the entrance with the rock hammer, cut the two fences in the sewer, and climb the ladder.

achievements.description: Play on the instruments for 1 hour of in-game time.
achievements.summary: Play musical instruments for a total of one in-game hour.

guide.context: Instruments are in Centre Perks 2.0, H.M.P Offshore and U.S.S Anomaly, often near social rooms.

steps.text: Play any instrument for one in-game hour, then walk away to unlock the achievement.

achievements.summary: Enter a multiplayer-only area.

guide.context: You need two players in the same game.

steps.text: Have one player hold a big brown sliding door open while the other goes through.
Continue into the area behind it, such as the next floor of the multiplayer escape route.

achievements.summary: Complete 100 favours.

guide.context: Some favours have a time limit.

steps.text: Accept favours from inmates with a green exclamation mark and finish each one. Do this 100 times.

achievements.description: Go 3 consecutive days without raising your Guard Heat above 0 in a single session.
achievements.summary: Go 3 days in a row without raising Guard Heat above 0 in one session.

guide.context: Heat rises from trespassing, being late to routines and violence. Progress counts in a single session only.

steps.text: Start a session in Rattlesnake Springs and follow the daily routine on time.
Stay unemployed and avoid fights, restricted areas and anything a guard could see as wrong.

achievements.summary: Play a Versus game online.

steps.text: In the main menu choose Versus, then join a friend's game or an open game.

achievements.summary: Play a Classic game online with another player.

guide.context: Public games may kick you, so a private game with a friend is safer.

steps.text: Set the connection to public or private, start a Classic game, and have another player join.

achievements.description: Complete the quota once for each of the jobs over multiple prisons/sessions.
achievements.summary: Complete the job quota once for each job.

guide.context: Only one job is free at the start of each prison. Progress carries across prisons and sessions.

steps.text: To get a held job, stop its owner reaching work: fight them or keep them talking until job time ends. They are fired, then apply at the job board.
Complete one quota in Shoemaking, Mail Sorting, Waste Disposal, Painting, Woodwork and Farming.
Complete one quota in Plumbing, Kitchen, Mining, Blacksmith, Kennels and Engineering.

achievements.description: Get mauled by a guard dog.
achievements.summary: Get mauled by a guard dog.

guide.context: Dogs are released above two stars of security or in lockdown, and attack you during lockdown.

steps.text: Trigger a lockdown: skip roll call, or knock out a guard and take his key or keycard.
Find a dog and let it maul you.

achievements.description: Gain a high enough opinion from a dog.
achievements.summary: Earn a high opinion from a dog.

steps.text: Take the Kennels job in H.M.P Offshore or Fort Tundra.
At job time, finish the feeding quota. Repeat if the achievement has not unlocked.

achievements.description: Spend 3 days total time in solitary over multiple prisons/sessions.
achievements.summary: Spend 3 in-game days in solitary in total.

guide.context: Time adds up across prisons and sessions. Repeat stays last up to five minutes, and peeling potatoes in solitary shortens the time.

steps.text: Press F4 then F1 to surrender. A medic takes you to solitary.
Repeat until you have spent 3 in-game days in total there. Do not peel the potatoes.

achievements.description: Attack a guard with a cake.
achievements.summary: Hit a guard with a cake.

steps.text: Reach Intellect 60. Gather sugar, flour and milk, then craft a cake.
Equip the cake in your first item slot and hit a guard with it.

achievements.displayName: Pour Us A Brew Will Yer, Love?
achievements.description: Make a cup of tea and gift it to another inmate or guard.
achievements.summary: Craft a cup of tea and give it to an inmate or guard.

guide.context: Intellect 30 is enough, and Centre Perks 2.0 has plenty of the ingredients.

steps.text: Combine a cup, a tea bag and sugar to craft tea.
Talk to an inmate or guard, click the present icon at the top left of the dialogue box and give the tea.

achievements.description: Fight another player in the U.S.S Anomaly, when you are both armed with energy swords.
achievements.summary: Fight another player in U.S.S Anomaly while you both hold energy swords.

guide.context: One player needs Intellect 70 and the energy sword recipe, which a payphone sells for 50 gold. Energy swords are contraband, so avoid metal detectors.

steps.text: Between you, craft two energy swords. The total cost is 4 batteries, 4 wires and 2 broom handles. Guards carry batteries and wires. The "Followers of Zegdethian Schlipp" favour also pays out a sword.
Go to a quiet area with the other player, equip the swords and fight.

achievements.summary: Use a customised character in a level.

guide.context: The tutorial does not count.

steps.text: In the main menu open My Characters, customise any convict, then start any level except the tutorial.

achievements.description: Spend 3 days total time in the showers over multiple prisons/sessions.
achievements.summary: Spend 3 in-game days in the showers in total.

guide.context: Time adds up across prisons and sessions.

steps.text: Use free time and time left after routines to interact with the shower stalls. Entering the room is not enough.

achievements.description: Escape H.M.P. Offshore on Snooty the Dolphin.
achievements.summary: Escape H.M.P Offshore on Snooty the Dolphin.

steps.text: Reach Intellect 70. Make a plastic red key. Also make a readied fishing rod using string, timber, a paper clip and a juicy worm.
Fish at the marked place, then give Snooty the fish and accept his quest.
Locate the book on speaking dolphin, then craft the cake Snooty requests.
Equip the cake and interact with Snooty to escape.

achievements.summary: Attend dinner without clothes.

guide.context: Not every prison has a dinner routine.

steps.text: Take off your jumpsuit in your stats inventory just before dinner, then enter the cafeteria.

achievements.description: Complete a quota of the Kitchen job whilst being naked.
achievements.summary: Complete a Kitchen job quota without clothes.

guide.context: Guards pass the kitchen and add heat while you are undressed.

steps.text: Take the Kitchen job in K.A.P.O.W Camp or U.S.S Anomaly.
At job time take off your jumpsuit and cook 4 pies to finish the quota.

achievements.summary: Tag 200 places in any prison.

steps.text: Press T to mark the floor. Repeat 200 times.

achievements.summary: Escape Area 17.

guide.context: Any route counts.

steps.text: Reach Intellect 60. Get an iron bar, a plastic red key, flimsy cutters, a guard outfit and an adrenaline shot, and put a bed dummy in your bed.
Wait at the marked place south until 00:00, then switch off the generator and go upstairs.
Cut the fence, then chip the wall with the iron bar. Drink the adrenaline shot if you tire, and leave.

achievements.description: Escape Wicked Ward by any means.
achievements.summary: Escape Wicked Ward by any route.

guide.context: Wicked Ward is a paid DLC prison.

steps.text: Finish the single-player or multiplayer escape, or any other route that works.

achievements.description: Complete the unique single player escape.
achievements.summary: Complete the single-player-only escape in Wicked Ward.

guide.context: This escape cannot be done with another player.

steps.text: Reach Intellect 60 and craft a plastic red key.
Take the "My Zombie" favour from Evan, usually the first inmate you meet. It has eight parts and rewards a special key.
Go to the north-west building, equip the key and click the coffin.

achievements.summary: Complete the multiplayer-only escape in Wicked Ward.

guide.context: This escape needs two players.

steps.text: Find a Bolt in desks. Take the Monster Leg from the desk behind the multiplayer door north-east on floor 2, and the Monster Arm from the cyan-door desk past the infirmary staff hall.
Place the Bolt, Leg and Arm on the table in the Professor's lab.
Use a fake red keycard above the lab. Have your partner carry the lightning conductor to the upper-left slot upstairs.
Return to the lab and click Escape on the monster.

achievements.description: Complete the ‘What it does in the shadows…’ quest.
achievements.summary: Finish the "What it does in the shadows..." favour.

guide.context: A random inmate offers it, so decline other favours until it appears.

steps.text: Give the inmate a bottle of aftershave.
Make a bed dummy (Intellect 40) out of 2 pillows plus a bed sheet, then hand it over.
Reach Intellect 60 and use a plastic red key to enter the basement. Take the wooden stake from the guard desk and give it.

achievements.description: Complete the ‘Bump in the night’ quest.
achievements.summary: Finish the "Bump in the night" favour.

guide.context: A random inmate offers it, so decline other favours until it appears.

steps.text: Find a family photo in a desk and give it.
Get a tin of paint from a desk and hand it over.
Reach Intellect 60 and craft an Escapists Figurine from glue, molten plastic and a readied paintbrush. Place it in the marked desk.

achievements.displayName: I ain’t afraid of no Ghost
achievements.description: Witness the ghost perform an otherworldly feat…
achievements.summary: See the ghost pass through a wall in Wicked Ward.

guide.context: You must be close, on the same floor, and looking at it. It can be unreliable.

steps.text: Play normally and watch for the ghost. It turns invisible, so stay near its floor until you see it cross a wall.

achievements.description: Escape Big Top Breakout by any means.
achievements.summary: Escape Big Top Breakout by any route.

guide.context: Big Top Breakout is a paid DLC prison.

steps.text: Finish the single-player or multiplayer escape, or any other route that works.

achievements.description: Complete the unique single player escape.
achievements.summary: Complete the single-player-only escape in Big Top Breakout.

guide.context: This escape cannot be done with another player.

steps.text: Reach Intellect 60. Find a crowbar, timber, 2 springs, duct tape, a hammer and a coconut in desks. The warden's table always has a spring.
Craft a Makeshift Launcher and a Makeshift Helmet.
Go east of the big tent to the Human Cannon. Repair it with the crowbar, add the launcher, then interact while wearing the helmet.

achievements.summary: Complete the multiplayer-only escape in Big Top Breakout.

guide.context: This escape needs two players.

steps.text: Reach Intellect 70 and make fake red and cyan keycards.
Take the Enclosure Keys from the desk behind the multiplayer door south of the kennels. Use the red keycard on the roof room and take the Teeth from its desk.
Craft a Wind-Up Mouse from the Teeth, string and a handkerchief.
Open the elephant lockup with the key. Use the cyan keycard behind the cage and release the mouse.

achievements.summary: Finish the "No Laughing Matter" favour.

guide.context: A random inmate offers it, so decline other favours until it appears.

steps.text: Deliver the letter to the named inmate.
Take a bow tie from a desk in the guard train cart and give it.
Craft lightweight cutters from 2 files and duct tape (Intellect 40) and give them.

achievements.displayName: It’s An Illusion, Not A Trick
achievements.summary: Finish the "Smoke and Mirrors" favour.

guide.context: The All-Seeing Nero offers it in the northern train cart from the start.

steps.text: Grab the bed dummy from above the stage and drop it in a toilet.
Craft a fake wall block from 2 papier-mache and a jar of ink (Intellect 40) and give it to Nero.
Craft a baseball bat from 2 timber and duct tape (Intellect 40) and knock out the named guard with it.

achievements.description: Avoid going to the Show Time routine for 3 days in a row.
achievements.summary: Skip the Show Time routine 3 days in a row.

guide.context: Show Time is held in the big tent in the centre.

steps.text: Stay away from Show Time for three days in a row.

achievements.description: Escape Dungeons and Duct Tape by any means.
achievements.summary: Escape Dungeons and Duct Tape by any route.

guide.context: Dungeons and Duct Tape is a paid DLC prison.

steps.text: Finish the single-player or multiplayer escape, or any other route that works.

achievements.description: Complete the unique single player escape.
achievements.summary: Complete the single-player-only escape in Dungeons and Duct Tape.

guide.context: This escape cannot be done with another player. A grappling hook is needed to reach some items.

steps.text: Craft a grappling hook and gather the escape items.
Raise Strength to 90 and place the items on the plinth on the 5th floor.

achievements.summary: Complete the multiplayer-only escape in Dungeons and Duct Tape.

guide.context: This escape needs two players. A grappling hook reaches the rooftops.

steps.text: Craft a grappling hook, a catapult beam, 2 half catapult frames and a catapult bucket.
Make a fake red keycard, use it on the red door south-east on floor 4, and use the grappling hook to climb 2 floors. Take the Catapult Counterweight from the desk.
Take every part to the multiplayer door on floor 3 south-west and build the catapult to escape.

achievements.displayName: Yo Dawg, I heard you like Exhibits
achievements.description: Complete the ‘It Belongs In A Museum’ quest.
achievements.summary: Finish the "It Belongs In A Museum" favour.

guide.context: A random inmate offers it, so decline other favours until it appears.

steps.text: Deliver the letter to the named guard.
Beat the named inmate unconscious, steal his toothbrush shiv, and flush it in a toilet.
Craft a makeshift halberd from molten metal, a broom handle and an iron bar (Intellect 70) and beat the named inmate with it.

achievements.summary: Finish the "Eternally Grateful" favour.

guide.context: A random inmate offers it, so decline other favours until it appears.

steps.text: Take a book from a desk and give it.
Take the stone tablet from the warden's desk on the top floor and give it. Enter with a plastic red key, a grappling hook or the vents.
Beat the named inmate unconscious, steal his cheap plastic chalice, and bring it to the favour giver.

achievements.summary: Use the royal throne in Dungeons and Duct Tape.

guide.context: The throne is a gilded toilet in the warden's bathroom on the top floor. A plastic red key, grappling hook or vent crawl gets you in.

steps.text: Flush any item down the gilded toilet.
